pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal dark-brown regions characterized by 4 to 6 vertices with high angularity. Edge gradients are moderately sharp in the high-contrast central flank, becoming softer due to image noise towards the periphery. The patches display a high spatial density relative to the inter-patch spacing.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous topological mesh of light-tan pixels forming negative space between patches. Junction nodes are primarily triradiate, with occasional quadriradiate intersections. The pixel thickness of these pathways is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, exhibiting slight narrowing in the posterior regions.
